name: Edge-Preserving Splatting with Compression/Stretching
definition: A volume rendering technique that preserves sharp edges by applying non-linear compression and stretching functions to the standard splatting kernel, ensuring C1 continuity (continuous first derivative) across splat boundaries.
summary: Edge-Preserving Splatting with Compression/Stretching sharpens volume rendering discontinuities by applying non-linear kernel modifications driven by edge direction and strength, ensuring C1 continuity across splat boundaries.
